# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(eulerr)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(writexl)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#hpa_data_v25 <- read_csv("data/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
hpa_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
head(hpa_data)

hpa_data_v24 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24/hpa_data_v24.csv")

tissue_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.24/rna_tissue_consensus.tsv")
head(tissue_data)

uniprot_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/uniprot_v24.csv")
head(uniprot_data)
```

# Themes

```{r}
hpa_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"    = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "No evidence"                  = "firebrick"
)

uniprot_colors <- c(
  "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)"    = "darkgreen",
  "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)" = "darkorange",
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"            = "#cccccc", 
  "Protein predicted (PE4)"                         = "#888888", 
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)"                         = "#444444",  
  "No evidence"                                     = "firebrick"
)
```

# Levels

```{r}
uniprot_levels <- c(
  "No evidence",
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
  "Protein predicted (PE4)",
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)",
  "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)",
  "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)"
)

hpa_levels <- c("Evidence at protein level",
                "Evidence at transcript level",
                "No evidence")

# Reverse hpa_levels
hpa_levels <- rev(hpa_levels)
```

```{r}
select <- dplyr::select
```

# Plots

## Sankey: Comparing HPA and UniProt evidence

```{r}
# Step 1: Prepare categorized evidence for Sankey plot
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when (is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No evidence",
                                               TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`))  |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Freq")

# Combine for scale
evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors, uniprot_colors)

# After count() step
sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `HPA evidence`     = factor(`HPA evidence`, levels = hpa_levels),
    `Uniprot evidence` = factor(`Uniprot evidence`, levels = uniprot_levels)
  )

# Calculate label with count for HPA and UniProt
sankey_data_label <- sankey_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`),
    names_to = "axis",
    values_to = "stratum"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis, stratum) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(stratum, "\n(", count, ")"))

# Sankey plot
ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(axis1 = `HPA evidence`,
           axis2 = `Uniprot evidence`,
           y     = Freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `HPA evidence`), width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5,
               color = "black"
  )  +
  # Custom labels with count below the stratum name
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(
      label = after_stat(
        paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")")
      )
    ),
    size = 4,
    vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("HPA Evidence", "UniProt Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey Plot of HPA and UniProt Evidence Categories",
    y = "Number of Genes",
    fill = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  # legend at top
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3A.pdf", width = 14, height = 20, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3A.png", width = 14, height = 20, dpi = 300)
```

## Sankey: Highlighting only genes that have no UniProt evidence

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
# Prepare data for Sankey
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when (is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No evidence",
                                               TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`)) |>
  filter(`Uniprot evidence` %in% c("No evidence", "Protein uncertain (PE5)", "Protein predicted (PE4)", "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)")) |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` != "No evidence") %>%
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Freq")

# Set color palettes
hpa_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level" = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "No evidence" = "firebrick"
)
uniprot_colors <- c(
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)" = "#cccccc",
  "Protein predicted (PE4)"              = "#888888",
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)"              = "#444444",
  "No evidence"                          = "#111111"
)
evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors, uniprot_colors)

# Order UniProt factor levels for better plotting
sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = factor(
      `Uniprot evidence`,
      levels = c(
        "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)",
        "Protein predicted (PE4)",
        "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
        "No evidence" 
      )
    )
  )

total_genes <- sum(sankey_data$Freq)

ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(
         axis1 = `Uniprot evidence`,
         axis2 = `HPA evidence`,
         y     = Freq
       )
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `Uniprot evidence`),
                width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")"))),
    size = 4, vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("UniProt", "HPA"),
    labels = c("UniProt Evidence", "HPA Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("HPA contributing genes v.24 (n = %d)", total_genes),
    y     = "Number of Genes",
    fill  = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3B.pdf", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3B.png", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Dataset contribution

### Venn: Protein level evidence

```{r}
# 1) identify your “contributing” proteins
hpa_contributing_proteins <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No evidence")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No evidence",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl)

# 2) extract the three sets of Ensembl IDs
wf    <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "Western blot",
    Evidence_type == "Western blot evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

ifluo <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "Immunofluorescence",
    Evidence_type == "Immunofluorescence evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

ihc   <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "Immunohistochemistry",
    Evidence_type == "Immunohistochemistry evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

# 3) build a named list for eulerr
venn_data <- list(
  `Western blot`          = wf,
  `Immunofluorescence`    = ifluo,
  `Immunohistochemistry`  = ihc
)

# check sizes
print(length(wf))
print(length(ifluo))
print(length(ihc))

# optional: see the intersection of all three
common_all <- Reduce(intersect, venn_data)
print(common_all)

# 4) fit & plot
venn_fit <- euler(venn_data)

venn_plot <- plot(
  venn_fit,
  fills      = list(
    `Western blot`         = "#75B2E9",
    `Immunofluorescence`   = "#FE625E",
    `Immunohistochemistry` = "#E8BCAD"
  ),
  quantities = TRUE,
  labels     = TRUE,
  main       = "HPA Protein‐Level Evidence Venn"
)

# PDF
ggsave(
  filename = "../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3C.pdf",
  plot     = venn_plot, 
  width    = 8, 
  height   = 6, 
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = cairo_pdf     # use cairo if you need embedded fonts
)

# PNG
ggsave(
  filename = "../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3C.png",
  plot     = venn_plot,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = "png"
)
```

### Upset: Transcript level evidence

```{r}
# 1) identify your “contributing” proteins
hpa_contributing_transcripts <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No evidence")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No evidence",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl)

# Define your protein evidence datasets
protein_datasets <- c("Western blot", "Immunohistochemistry", "Immunofluorescence")
rna_datasets <- c("Tissue", "Brain", "Cell type", "Immune cell type", "Cell line")

# Filter and select
upset_base <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% rna_datasets) %>%
  filter(Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_transcripts)
  

# Make a binary wide matrix: 1 if evidence in dataset, 0 otherwise
upset_data <- upset_base %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, Evidence_type) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Evidence_type, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

set_order <- c("Tissue evidence", "Brain evidence", "Cell type evidence", "Immune cell type evidence", "Cell line evidence")
# Reverse the order for plotting
set_order <- rev(set_order)
upset_data <- upset_data[, c("Ensembl", set_order)]

upset_contributing_transcripts <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 4
      ) 
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over",
)

upset_contributing_transcripts

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3D.pdf", width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3D.png", width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Sankey: Tissue specificity

```{r}
# 1) identify your “contributing” proteins
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No evidence")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No evidence",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" | `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`),  by = "Ensembl") |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `RNA tissue specificity`, name = "Freq")

# ---- 1. Re-factor tissue specificity in the desired order ----
desired_tissue_levels <- c(
  "Tissue enriched",
  "Group enriched",
  "Tissue enhanced",
  "Low tissue specificity",
  "Not detected"
)

sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `RNA tissue specificity` = factor(
      `RNA tissue specificity`,
      levels = desired_tissue_levels
    )
  )

# ---- 2. Build your colour vectors ----
hpa_evidence_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"    = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "No evidence"                  = "firebrick"
)

tissue_spec_colors <- c(
  "Tissue enriched"         = "#E31A1B",
  "Group enriched"          = "#FE9D00",
  "Tissue enhanced"         = "#B65EC4",
  "Low tissue specificity"  = "#7D7D7D",
  "Not detected"            = "#E4E4E4"
)

all_colors <- c(hpa_evidence_colors, tissue_spec_colors)

# ---- 3. Draw the Sankey with HPA on the left, tissue on the right ----
p <- ggplot(
  sankey_data,
  aes(
    axis1 = `HPA evidence`,
    axis2 = `RNA tissue specificity`,
    y     = Freq
  )
) +
  # alluvia coloured by the HPA evidence
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `HPA evidence`),
                width = 0.3, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "gray50", size = 0.2) +
  # strata on both sides, each side uses the same fill mapping
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")"))),
            size = 4, vjust = 1.2) +
  # label the two axes in the correct order
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("HPA Evidence", "RNA Tissue Specificity"),
    name   = NULL,
    expand = c(.05, .05)
  ) +
  # supply the unified palette
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_colors) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("HPA evidence → RNA tissue specificity\n(n = %d genes)", sum(sankey_data$Freq)),
    y     = "Number of Genes",
    fill  = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# display
print(p)

# ---- 4. Save ----
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3E.pdf", p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3E.png", p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## UMAP: 

### HPA contributing genes

```{r}
hpa_contributing_tissue_detected_genes <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No evidence")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No evidence",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" | `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`),  by = "Ensembl") |>
  filter(`RNA tissue specificity` != "Not detected")

umap_data <- tissue_data %>%
  rename(Ensembl = Gene) |>
  filter(Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_tissue_detected_genes$Ensembl) |>
  inner_join(hpa_contributing_tissue_detected_genes |> select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`, `RNA tissue specificity`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(`RNA tissue specificity` = factor(`RNA tissue specificity`, levels = c("Tissue enriched", "Group enriched", "Tissue enhanced", "Low tissue specificity")))

umap_hd <- hd_umap(dat = umap_data |> 
          select(Ensembl, Tissue, nTPM) |> 
          pivot_wider(names_from = Ensembl, values_from = nTPM),
        by_sample = FALSE,
        impute = TRUE,
        components = 2,
        seed = 123)

umap <- umap_hd$umap_res |>
  rename(Ensembl = Features) |>
  inner_join(umap_data, by = "Ensembl")
```

```{r}
max_tissue_per_gene <- umap %>% 
  # your big tibble
  group_by(Ensembl) %>%          # group by gene (you can drop Gene_name if you don’t need it)
  slice_max(nTPM, with_ties = FALSE) %>%    # take the single row with highest nTPM
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(Ensembl, Tissue, nTPM) %>% 
  rename(
    `Max tissue` = Tissue,
    `Max nTPM`   = nTPM
  )

p_umap <- ggplot(umap |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
                   inner_join(max_tissue_per_gene, by = "Ensembl"),

    y = "UMAP2",

  ) +

    plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)

```

```{r}
# define the tissues you want special colours for
highlighted <- c(
  "bone marrow", "brain", "intestine", "liver",
  "lymphoid tissue", "retina", "skeletal muscle", "testis"
)

# pick one colour per tissue (I’ve just grabbed a palette, feel free to swap)
tissue_colours <- c(
  "bone marrow"     = "#1b9e77",
  "brain"           = "#d95f02",
  "intestine"       = "#7570b3",
  "liver"           = "#e7298a",
  "lymphoid tissue" = "#66a61e",
  "retina"          = "#e6ab02",
  "skeletal muscle" = "#a6761d",
  "testis"          = "#666666",
  "Other"           = "grey80"
)

# prepare your “max tissue” per gene:
max_tissue_per_gene <- umap %>% 
  group_by(Ensembl) %>% 
  slice_max(nTPM, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(Ensembl, Tissue, nTPM) %>% 
  rename(
    `Max tissue` = Tissue,
    `Max nTPM`   = nTPM
  ) %>% 
  # collapse “other” tissues into one factor level:
  mutate(
    Tissue_group = if_else(
      `Max tissue` %in% highlighted,
      `Max tissue`,
      "Other"
    ) %>% 
      # make it a factor, with "Other" last
      factor(levels = c(highlighted, "Other"))
  )

# now join and plot
p_umap <- umap %>% 
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  inner_join(max_tissue_per_gene, by = "Ensembl") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = UMAP1, 
    y = UMAP2, 
    color = Tissue_group,
    shape = `HPA evidence`
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    # supply your 8 colours, + grey for “Other”
    values = c(tissue_colours, Other = "grey80"),
    name   = "Max tissue"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP of HPA Contributing Genes",
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    shape = "HPA evidence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_umap)
```

```{r}
 hpa_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, Uniprot, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_info %>% select(Entry, `Protein existence`),
    by = c("Uniprot" = "Entry")
  ) %>%
  rename(`UniProt evidence` = `Protein existence`) %>%
  mutate(
    HPA = case_when(
      is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
    ),
    UniProt = case_when(
      is.na(`UniProt evidence`) ~ "NA",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Inferred from homology" ~ "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Predicted" ~ "PE4: Predicted",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Uncertain" ~ "PE5: Uncertain",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" ~ "PE1: Evidence at protein level",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level" ~ "PE2: Evidence at transcript level",
      TRUE ~ `UniProt evidence`
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    UniProt %in% c(
      "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      "PE4: Predicted",
      "PE5: Uncertain",
      "NA"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(HPA != "NA") %>%
  filter(HPA != "No human protein/transcript evidence") |>
  inner_join(hpa_data |> select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  # Write to excel
  write_csv("../tables/Figure 2/Supplementary tables.csv")
```
